newOwner parameter is written into _owner by transferOwnership.
marketingAddress parameter becomes the new privileged _marketingAddress.
amount parameter is forwarded to swapTokensForEth by manualswap.
sniper parameter is flagged in _isSniper by addSniper.
hoursTime parameter determines the jeets window written by setTimeJeets.
contractTokenBalance local drives swap/burn decisions in _transfer.
canSwap local controls the auto-swap branch in _transfer.
tAmount parameter is decomposed into fee amounts by _getValues.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner is only meaningful as the argument written to _owner by transferOwnership.
Parameter marketingAddress exists solely to update the privileged _marketingAddress in setMarketingWallet.
Parameter amount belongs to the manualswap entry point that forwards it to swapTokensForEth.
Parameter sniper is only used to set the _isSniper flag in addSniper.
Parameter hoursTime is only used to compute the jeets window in setTimeJeets.
Local contractTokenBalance is a transient computation inside _transfer's swap logic.
Local canSwap is a transient boolean deciding the auto-swap branch in _transfer.
Parameter tAmount is the input decomposed by _getValues into transfer/fee amounts.
